1.web: I will sing of the loving kindness of Yahweh forever. With my mouth, I will make known your faithfulness to all generations.
1.asv: I will sing of the lovingkindness of Jehovah for ever: With my mouth will I make known thy faithfulness to all generations.

2.web: I indeed declare, “Love stands firm forever. You established the heavens. Your faithfulness is in them.”
2.asv: For I have said, Mercy shall be built up for ever; Thy faithfulness wilt thou establish in the very heavens.

3.web: “I have made a covenant with my chosen one, I have sworn to David, my servant,
3.asv: I have made a covenant with my chosen, I have sworn unto David my servant:

4.web: ‘I will establish your seed forever, and build up your throne to all generations.’” Selah.
4.asv: Thy seed will I establish for ever, And build up thy throne to all generations. [Selah

5.web: The heavens will praise your wonders, Yahweh; your faithfulness also in the assembly of the holy ones.
5.asv: And the heavens shall praise thy wonders, O Jehovah; Thy faithfulness also in the assembly of the holy ones.

6.web: For who in the skies can be compared to Yahweh? Who among the sons of the heavenly beings is like Yahweh,
6.asv: For who in the skies can be compared unto Jehovah? Who among the sons of the mighty is like unto Jehovah,

7.web: a very awesome God in the council of the holy ones, to be feared above all those who are around him?
7.asv: A God very terrible in the council of the holy ones, And to be feared above all them that are round about him?

8.web: Yahweh, God of Armies, who is a mighty one, like you? Yah, your faithfulness is around you.
8.asv: O Jehovah God of hosts, Who is a mighty one, like unto thee, O Jehovah? And thy faithfulness is round about thee.

9.web: You rule the pride of the sea. When its waves rise up, you calm them.
9.asv: Thou rulest the pride of the sea: When the waves thereof arise, thou stillest them.

10.web: You have broken Rahab in pieces, like one of the slain. You have scattered your enemies with your mighty arm.
10.asv: Thou hast broken Rahab in pieces, as one that is slain; Thou hast scattered thine enemies with the arm of thy strength.

11.web: The heavens are yours. The earth also is yours; the world and its fullness. You have founded them.
11.asv: The heavens are thine, the earth also is thine: The world and the fulness thereof, thou hast founded them.

12.web: The north and the south, you have created them. Tabor and Hermon rejoice in your name.
12.asv: The north and the south, thou hast created them: Tabor and Hermon rejoice in thy name.

13.web: You have a mighty arm. Your hand is strong, and your right hand is exalted.
13.asv: Thou hast a mighty arm; Strong is thy hand, and high is thy right hand.

14.web: Righteousness and justice are the foundation of your throne. Loving kindness and truth go before your face.
14.asv: Righteousness and justice are the foundation of thy throne: Lovingkindness and truth go before thy face.

15.web: Blessed are the people who learn to acclaim you. They walk in the light of your presence, Yahweh.
15.asv: Blessed is the people that know the joyful sound: They walk, O Jehovah, in the light of thy countenance.

16.web: In your name they rejoice all day. In your righteousness, they are exalted.
16.asv: In thy name do they rejoice all the day; And in thy righteousness are they exalted.

17.web: For you are the glory of their strength. In your favor, our horn will be exalted.
17.asv: For thou art the glory of their strength; And in thy favor our horn shall be exalted.

18.web: For our shield belongs to Yahweh; our king to the Holy One of Israel.
18.asv: For our shield belongeth unto Jehovah; And our king to the Holy One of Israel.

19.web: Then you spoke in vision to your saints, and said, “I have bestowed strength on the warrior. I have exalted a young man from the people.
19.asv: Then thou spakest in vision to thy saints, And saidst, I have laid help upon one that is mighty; I have exalted one chosen out of the people.

20.web: I have found David, my servant. I have anointed him with my holy oil,
20.asv: I have found David my servant; With my holy oil have I anointed him:

21.web: with whom my hand shall be established. My arm will also strengthen him.
21.asv: With whom my hand shall be established; Mine arm also shall strengthen him.

22.web: No enemy will tax him. No wicked man will oppress him.
22.asv: The enemy shall not exact from him, Nor the son of wickedness afflict him.

23.web: I will beat down his adversaries before him, and strike those who hate him.
23.asv: And I will beat down his adversaries before him, And smite them that hate him.

24.web: But my faithfulness and my loving kindness will be with him. In my name, his horn will be exalted.
24.asv: But my faithfulness and my lovingkindness shall be with him; And in my name shall his horn be exalted.

25.web: I will set his hand also on the sea, and his right hand on the rivers.
25.asv: I will set his hand also on the sea, And his right hand on the rivers.

26.web: He will call to me, ‘You are my Father, my God, and the rock of my salvation!’
26.asv: He shall cry unto me, Thou art my Father, My God, and the rock of my salvation.

27.web: I will also appoint him my firstborn, the highest of the kings of the earth.
27.asv: I also will make him my first-born, The highest of the kings of the earth.

28.web: I will keep my loving kindness for him forever more. My covenant will stand firm with him.
28.asv: My lovingkindness will I keep for him for evermore; And my covenant shall stand fast with him.

29.web: I will also make his seed endure forever, and his throne as the days of heaven.
29.asv: His seed also will I make to endure for ever, And his throne as the days of heaven.

30.web: If his children forsake my law, and don’t walk in my ordinances;
30.asv: If his children forsake my law, And walk not in mine ordinances;

31.web: if they break my statutes, and don’t keep my commandments;
31.asv: If they break my statutes, And keep not my commandments;

32.web: then I will punish their sin with the rod, and their iniquity with stripes.
32.asv: Then will I visit their transgression with the rod, And their iniquity with stripes.

33.web: But I will not completely take my loving kindness from him, nor allow my faithfulness to fail.
33.asv: But my lovingkindness will I not utterly take from him, Nor suffer my faithfulness to fail.

34.web: I will not break my covenant, nor alter what my lips have uttered.
34.asv: My covenant will I not break, Nor alter the thing that is gone out of my lips.

35.web: Once have I sworn by my holiness, I will not lie to David.
35.asv: Once have I sworn by my holiness: I will not lie unto David:

36.web: His seed will endure forever, his throne like the sun before me.
36.asv: His seed shall endure for ever, And his throne as the sun before me.

37.web: It will be established forever like the moon, the faithful witness in the sky.” Selah.
37.asv: It shall be established for ever as the moon, Andasthe faithful witness in the sky. [Selah

38.web: But you have rejected and spurned. You have been angry with your anointed.
38.asv: But thou hast cast off and rejected, Thou hast been wroth with thine anointed.

39.web: You have renounced the covenant of your servant. You have defiled his crown in the dust.
39.asv: Thou hast abhorred the covenant of thy servant: Thou hast profaned his crown by casting it to the ground.

40.web: You have broken down all his hedges. You have brought his strongholds to ruin.
40.asv: Thou hast broken down all his hedges; Thou hast brought his strongholds to ruin.

41.web: All who pass by the way rob him. He has become a reproach to his neighbors.
41.asv: All that pass by the way rob him: He is become a reproach to his neighbors.

42.web: You have exalted the right hand of his adversaries. You have made all of his enemies rejoice.
42.asv: Thou hast exalted the right hand of his adversaries; Thou hast made all his enemies to rejoice.

43.web: Yes, you turn back the edge of his sword, and haven’t supported him in battle.
43.asv: Yea, thou turnest back the edge of his sword, And hast not made him to stand in the battle.

44.web: You have ended his splendor, and thrown his throne down to the ground.
44.asv: Thou hast made his brightness to cease, And cast his throne down to the ground.

45.web: You have shortened the days of his youth. You have covered him with shame. Selah.
45.asv: The days of his youth hast thou shortened: Thou hast covered him with shame. [Selah

46.web: How long, Yahweh? Will you hide yourself forever? Will your wrath burn like fire?
46.asv: How long, O Jehovah? wilt thou hide thyself for ever? How longshall thy wrath burn like fire?

47.web: Remember how short my time is! For what vanity have you created all the children of men!
47.asv: Oh remember how short my time is: For what vanity hast thou created all the children of men!

48.web: What man is he who shall live and not see death, who shall deliver his soul from the power of Sheol? Selah.
48.asv: What man is he that shall live and not see death, That shall deliver his soul from the power of Sheol? [Selah

49.web: Lord, where are your former loving kindnesses, which you swore to David in your faithfulness?
49.asv: Lord, where are thy former lovingkindnesses, Which thou swarest unto David in thy faithfulness?

50.web: Remember, Lord, the reproach of your servants, how I bear in my heart the taunts of all the mighty peoples,
50.asv: Remember, Lord, the reproach of thy servants; How I do bear in my bosom the reproach of all the mighty peoples,

51.web: With which your enemies have mocked, Yahweh, with which they have mocked the footsteps of your anointed one.
51.asv: Wherewith thine enemies have reproached, O Jehovah, Wherewith they have reproached the footsteps of thine anointed.

52.web: Blessed be Yahweh forever more. Amen, and Amen.
52.asv: Blessed be Jehovah for evermore. Amen, and Amen.
